comments.text: Hi, Simon. I have problem with speaking.My results is 8.5；8.5；7.0；6.5, which is not bad overall, but it doesn't meet the requirement of "at least 7 for each part". I was not worried about my speaking at all before, even though english is my second language, i have lived in Australia for almost three years; i completed my postgraduate study in Australia; i rarely have difficulty on communicating with my local friends and I have lots of practice every day. So i don't know why i can only get 6.5 or how to improve my speaking for IELTS. Especially the second part, i was given 1-2 minutes to write something but the time was never enough, and then another 2 minutes of talking, i was told "time is up" when my story was just started...

comments.author: Mahsa
comments.text:
Hi Diogo,

I dont think you can submit or apply for anywhere with this result. Don't be satisfied with two higher numbers. You still need to get 7+ in speaking and writing. I think your passive abilities such as listening and reading are higher than active abilities include writing and speaking. But good news is you benefit from good lexicon and can develop your skills to get appropriate results. Good luck

Mahsa
